calibration.method: controlled single-variable ablation on this config as the only baseline, 12 cases (8 train + 4 held-out), each with an NCU hardware reference aligned by 1-based launch ordinal + full demangled name + grid/block shape

accuracy_counters.note: warp_instructions, l2_read_sectors and l2_read_hits match hardware exactly (0.00% bias) on all 12 cases

known_limitations: The selected l2_rop_latency=237 / dram_latency=324 are the official tuner residual-stage medians, NOT an end-to-end optimum: a sensitivity sweep over 12 cases each finds lower MAPE at l2=250 (7.03%) and dram=360/400 (6.49%/6.48%). The difference is not significant at n=12, and dram=400 degrades held-out to 10.00%, so the selection was kept.
All candidates share one worst case, l2hold_m16_p4_b192_t256_i4, stuck at about +20%. This is a structural modelling gap that latency tuning cannot fix.

indexing=0 is a compensating approximation, not a claim that Ada hardware uses linear partition mapping. Real Ada hashes; the simulator's IPoly implementation with this address-bit layout over-camps partitions and inflates cycles, so indexing=0 removes that simulator-side artefact. The physical mapping remains unknown.

notes: EXPERIMENTAL RTX4000 Ada migration from official SM86_RTX3070; not validated/tuned.
SM/register/occupancy/L2/memory-clock values come from cudaGetDeviceProperties JSON.
Core frequency must match the fixed hardware profiling clock; CUDA max clock alone is not evidence of actual clock.
Interconnect and L2 clocks are approximated by the SM clock as in the RTX3070 baseline.
16-bit controllers and two L2 subpartitions/controller are model assumptions, not measured topology.
L2 capacity is exact; 16-way organization and XOR set hashing are unvalidated approximations.
L2 uses X (XOR), since inherited P/IPOLY only supports 16/32/64 sets, not 1024.

Partition hashing stays 2: IPOLY over next-power-of-two then modulo 20; physical Ada mapping is unknown. NOTE: the calibrated configuration changes this to 0 (see the calibration block above); this shipped file still carries the official value.
Do not use indexing=6 here: its IPOLY group count is 4, unsupported by the current hashing.cc.
All FU latencies/initiation, tensor timing, DRAM timings, cache latencies, queues and launch latency are inherited and uncalibrated.
Power modeling is disabled: no RTX4000 Ada AccelWattch power model is claimed.
No TMA/WGMMA/Hopper behavior is enabled. Unknown trace opcodes remain fatal.
